name: Effective VC Radius of the Order-Shattering/Effective-VC-Radius Separation Class
proof: All three coordinates are effective and hence individually shattered. On $\{x_1,x_2\}$ the class realizes only $00,01,10$, so not every pair is shattered. Therefore the effective VC radius is one; this is checked by $\texttt{sync/verify\_order\_shattering\_separation.py}$.
